summary: test_babysit_merge_files_deferred_issues_before_the_merge_queue_steps does exact-text equality on the real composed babysit-merge instructions (via discover_workflows -> workflow.skills(), no mocks) for all 3 built-in 2119 workflows; monkeypatch counterexample removing item 3 ('Skip any suggested issue the user explicitly rejected.') from the source constant makes the assertion fail as expected, confirming it's a genuine behavioral check, not keyword theater.
